title: The real reason tech companies are firing engineers

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the real reason tech companies are cutting engineering roles isn't just cost, but a shift in how we build and deploy technology?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI tools now automate code writing, testing, and deployment, reducing the need for large engineering teams in some areas.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This risks devaluing human expertise and widening the gap between those who understand and control these technologies.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on AI oversight, security, and hybrid human-AI workflows to maintain quality and ethical standards.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, engineers may shift to guiding AI systems, ensuring they align with human values and societal needs.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of engineering lies in collaboration — between humans, AI, and the ethical frameworks that guide their work.

video_cue: A montage of engineers and AI systems working side by side in a high-tech lab, with data streams and code visualizations.
